title: A Realized One Still Exists
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 24.15 Linked Discourses 24.15
  • 1. Sotāpattivagga 1. Stream-Entry

Hotitathāgatosutta A Realized One Still Exists

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise: ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’”ti? ‘A realized one still exists after death’?” …

“Bhagavaṁmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā …pe… niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

Pannarasamaṁ.
